resources.string: When a call ends, this phone keeps the number, time, type, and duration. Records stay here even if you clear the phone\'s call history. With the notification on, they are saved right after a call ends. Without it, the app checks again about every %1$d hours. Records stay only on this phone. Force-stopping the app pauses immediate saving until you open it again.
